summary: High Tide Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting voting results from its annual general and special meeting held virtually on August 11, 2026. Shareholders re-appointed Davidson Company LLP as auditor, fixed board size at five, elected all five director nominees, and ratified a restated shareholder rights plan adopted June 26, 2026. Approximately 15.87% of outstanding shares were represented. This is a routine post-meeting disclosure mirroring a US Form 8-K Item 5.07, containing no transactional or special-situation elements. It is a standard governance update with no strategic implications.
